How are you stretching?

It is the first question I ask whenever someone tells me their stretching is not working. Most people are pulling too hard, holding too short, breath locked, treating it like a one-rep max for the muscle.

Stretching is an instruction to the nervous system. Pull aggressively on something tight and the nervous system tightens it more. Slow, low, breath out, repeated. That is what opens range that stays.

If you start at an 8 out of 10, 8 is the ceiling. Start at a 3 and the 3 turns into a 5 over time. Most people skip that math and wonder why nothing changes.

If you have been stretching for years and the tightness keeps coming back, send me a DM and let's look at how you are doing it.

Be Good. Help Someone. Learn Lots.
